title: Breaking the Bollobás-Eldridge-Catlin Barrier for Bipartite Graphs
summary: The celebrated Bollobás-Eldridge-Catlin packing conjecture states that every $n$-vertex graph $G$ with minimum degree at least $\big(1-\frac{1}{Δ+1}\big) n$ contains every $n$-vertex graph $H$ of maximum degree at most $Δ$. Despite considerable attention, the conjecture remains widely open. We show that for bipartite $H$ this threshold can be greatly improved: there is an absolute constant $c>0$ such that every $n$-vertex graph $G$ with minimum degree at least $ \big(1-c\frac{\logΔ}Δ\big)n $ contains every $n$-vertex bipartite graph $H$ of maximum degree at most $Δ$, provided $Δ$ is not too…
